description: This source file sets up and runs native tests within an Android application, integrating Google Test with Android logging, signal crash detection, and command-line argument parsing. It includes functions for handling signals, logging test results, and initializing the test environment on Android.

classes.name: AndroidLogPrinter
classes.description: Custom Google Test event listener that logs test progress and results to Android logcat.

methods.name: RunTests
methods.description: Main function invoked on a separate thread to initialize and run the native tests within the Android environment.

methods.name: JNI_OnLoad
methods.description: JNI entry point called when the shared library is loaded, sets up crash handlers and initializes the Android environment.
